# Apply online for a UK passport

Use this service to apply for, renew, replace or update your passport and pay for it online.

This service is also available [in Welsh (Cymraeg)](https://www.gov.uk/gwneud-cais-adnewyddu-pasbort).

If your passport is burgundy or has ‘European Union’ on the cover, you can continue to use it until it expires.

## How long it takes

[Check how long it will take to get a passport](https://www.gov.uk/government/organisations/hm-passport-office/about-our-services) before you apply.

If you need a passport urgently, you can [find out more about the Online Premium or 1 week Fast Track services](https://www.gov.uk/get-a-passport-urgently).

Do not book travel until you have a valid passport - your new passport will not have the same number as your old one.

## Before you start

You’ll need a debit or credit card to use this service.

[It’s £13.50 cheaper](https://www.gov.uk/passport-fees) to apply for a passport online than by post.

You can get help making an online passport application with the digital [Check and Send service](https://www.gov.uk/how-the-post-office-check-and-send-service-works) at a Post Office.

## Apply online

[Start now](https://www.passport.service.gov.uk/)

## Other ways to apply

### Help applying online

You can get help with your online application at a Post Office. Staff can:

- take your digital photo
- help you fill in the application online

This service costs extra. Find out more about the digital [Check and Send service](https://www.gov.uk/how-the-post-office-check-and-send-service-works).

You can pay by cash, or debit or credit card.

### Paper forms

You can pick up a paper passport application form from your [local Post Office](https://www.postoffice.co.uk/) and apply by post. It takes longer to apply by post than online.

If you need help, Post Office staff can check you’ve filled in the form correctly - but you’ll need to provide your own photos. This service costs extra. Find out more about the paper [Check and Send service](https://www.gov.uk/how-the-post-office-check-and-send-service-works).

You can pay by cash, or debit or credit card.
